data_description.pin: If set, the page asks for this PIN. Leave it empty on a trusted network.

user.description: Adds Gulavillan to the sidebar. You sign in with your normal Home Assistant account. A PIN here is only asked again when arming or disarming the alarm.
user.title: Gulavillan

port_in_use.description: Gulavillan could not listen on port {port}. Open the integration and choose another port.
port_in_use.title: The port is in use

error.invalid_port: Choose a port from 1024 to 65535, other than Home Assistant's own port.
error.port_in_use: That port is already in use.

data_description.pin: If set, the page asks for this PIN. Leave it empty on a trusted network.
data_description.port: The page moves to this port as soon as you save. Home Assistant does not need a restart.
data_description.villa_outdoor: Sensor on the villa's outdoor number. Empty lets the page choose.
data_description.villa_indoor: Sensor on the villa's indoor number. Empty lets the page choose.
data_description.villa_humidity: Sensor on the villa. Empty lets the page choose.
data_description.villa_climate: Climate entity used when the indoor sensor has no value.
data_description.villa_door: Door sensor drawn on the villa. Empty lets the page choose.
data_description.villa_lights: Order is the windows, left to right, then the porch lamp.
data_description.light_switches: Switches to show and toggle together with lights.
data_description.power_sensor: Whole-home power. Empty lets the page choose.
data_description.energy_sensor: A sensor that already shows today's energy, such as a utility meter.
data_description.price_sensor: Price per kWh. Empty lets the page choose a sensor with that unit.
data_description.charger_entities: Extra charger entities. Known charger integrations are included automatically.
data_description.sidebar_title: Name shown in the Home Assistant sidebar.
data_description.sidebar_icon: Icon shown next to the sidebar title.
data_description.panel_admin_only: Hide the sidebar page from users who are not administrators.
data_description.legacy_server: Also serve the page on its own port. Leave this off. It is only for an old kiosk and will be removed.

init.description: The page is in the sidebar. The separate port stays off unless you turn it on below. Do not use Home Assistant's own port.
init.title: Gulavillan

update_frontend.name: Update page
update_frontend.description: Download the Gulavillan page from GitHub into /config/www/gulavillan. No restart is needed.

ref.name: Branch or tag
ref.description: Optional git ref. Leave empty to use the latest release.

rollback_frontend.name: Restore previous page
rollback_frontend.description: Put back the previous Gulavillan page. No restart is needed.
